account_entries_status_shape_check.name: account_entries_status_shape_check
account_entries_status_shape_check.value:
(
        "account_entries"."status"::text = 'POSTED'
        and "account_entries"."posted_on" is not null
        and "account_entries"."expected_on" is null
      )
      or (
        "account_entries"."status"::text = 'EXPECTED'
        and "account_entries"."expected_on" is not null
        and "account_entries"."posted_on" is null
      )

budget_movements_source_reference_shape_.name: budget_movements_source_reference_shape_check
budget_movements_source_reference_shape_.value:
"budget_movements"."source_reference_id" is null or (
        char_length("budget_movements"."source_reference_id") between 1 and 256
        and "budget_movements"."source_reference_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
      )

budget_movements_transfer_reference_shap.name: budget_movements_transfer_reference_shape_check
budget_movements_transfer_reference_shap.value:
"budget_movements"."transfer_reference_id" is null or (
        char_length("budget_movements"."transfer_reference_id") between 1 and 256
        and "budget_movements"."transfer_reference_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
      )

budgets_status_shape_check.name: budgets_status_shape_check
budgets_status_shape_check.value:
(
        ("budgets"."status"::text = 'ACTIVE' and "budgets"."closed_on" is null)
        or
        ("budgets"."status"::text = 'CLOSED' and "budgets"."closed_on" is not null)
      )

budgets_target_shape_check.name: budgets_target_shape_check
budgets_target_shape_check.value:
(
        ("budgets"."target_amount_cents" is null and "budgets"."target_date" is null)
        or
        (
          "budgets"."target_amount_cents" > 0
          and "budgets"."target_date" is not null
          and "budgets"."target_date" >= "budgets"."active_from"
        )
      )

financial_events_reversal_shape_check.name: financial_events_reversal_shape_check
financial_events_reversal_shape_check.value:
(
        ("financial_events"."kind" = 'REVERSAL'
          and "financial_events"."origin" = 'SYSTEM'
          and "financial_events"."status" = 'POSTED'
          and "financial_events"."reversal_of_event_id" is not null)
        or
        ("financial_events"."kind" <> 'REVERSAL'
          and "financial_events"."origin"::text in ('MANUAL', 'IMPORT')
          and ("financial_events"."origin"::text = 'MANUAL' or "financial_events"."status" = 'POSTED')
          and "financial_events"."reversal_of_event_id" is null)
      )

job_executions_error_code_shape_check.name: job_executions_error_code_shape_check
job_executions_error_code_shape_check.value:
"job_executions"."error_code" is null or (
        char_length(btrim("job_executions"."error_code")) between 1 and 64
        and "job_executions"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$'
      )

job_executions_finished_at_shape_check.name: job_executions_finished_at_shape_check
job_executions_finished_at_shape_check.value:
(
        ("job_executions"."status"::text = 'RUNNING' and "job_executions"."finished_at" is null)
        or
        ("job_executions"."status"::text <> 'RUNNING' and "job_executions"."finished_at" is not null)
      )

planned_events_status_shape_check.name: planned_events_status_shape_check
planned_events_status_shape_check.value:
(
        "planned_events"."status"::text = 'POSTED'
        and "planned_events"."financial_event_id" is not null
      )
      or (
        "planned_events"."status"::text <> 'POSTED'
        and "planned_events"."financial_event_id" is null
        and "planned_events"."is_partial" = false
      )

recurring_occurrences_status_shape_check.name: recurring_occurrences_status_shape_check
recurring_occurrences_status_shape_check.value:
(
        "recurring_occurrences"."status"::text = 'POSTED'
        and "recurring_occurrences"."financial_event_id" is not null
      )
      or (
        "recurring_occurrences"."status"::text <> 'POSTED'
        and "recurring_occurrences"."financial_event_id" is null
        and "recurring_occurrences"."is_partial" = false
      )

recurring_rules_day_rule_shape_check.name: recurring_rules_day_rule_shape_check
recurring_rules_day_rule_shape_check.value:
(
        ("recurring_rules"."day_rule" = 'FIXED_DAY'
          and "recurring_rules"."day_of_month" between 1 and 31)
        or
        ("recurring_rules"."day_rule" <> 'FIXED_DAY'
          and "recurring_rules"."day_of_month" is null)
      )

transaction_import_items_external_id_che.name: transaction_import_items_external_id_check
transaction_import_items_external_id_che.value:
"transaction_import_items"."external_id" is null
        or (char_length("transaction_import_items"."external_id") between 1 and 128
          and "transaction_import_items"."external_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')
